program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (grid)
         (let ((objs (objects grid 0)))
           (cellmap grid
                    (r c v)
                    (if (zero? v)
                        0
                        (let ((containing (filter (lambda (o)
                                                    (and
                                                      (>= r (fst (obj-bbox o)))
                                                      (<= r (nth (obj-bbox o) 2))
                                                      (>= c (nth (obj-bbox o) 1))
                                                      (<= c (nth (obj-bbox o) 3))))
                                                  objs)))
                          (if (null? containing)
                              v
                              (obj-color (car (sort-by containing
                                                       (lambda (o)
                                                         (* -1
                                                            (* (+ 1
                                                                  (- (nth (obj-bbox o)
                                                                          2)
                                                                     (fst (obj-bbox o))))
                                                               (+ 1
                                                                  (- (nth (obj-bbox o)
                                                                          3)
                                                                     (nth (obj-bbox o)
                                                                          1))))))))))))))))
